notes: Rule 11: a rescript from an Imam («فكتب لا بأس به») with the asker's letter: the route is asker («أباه», a bare relation) then the Imam «أبي الحسن», as the text writes him; the route is not completed.
«- جعفر بن محمد بن يونس»: the first link follows «و روي عن» (rule 10 bullet on «روي»).

Rule 11: a rescript from an Imam («فكتب لا بأس به») with the asker's letter: the route is asker («أباه», a bare relation) then the Imam «أبي الحسن», as the text writes him; the route is not completed.
«- جعفر بن محمد بن يونس»: the first link follows «و روي عن» (rule 10 bullet on «روي»).
«أَنَّ أَبَاهُ كَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ» : the asker is a relation link, then the Imam asked (rule 5); the Imam is written as the text names him, never completed
needs_ruling: the saying «فَكَتَبَ» is a rescript from an Imam (rule 11)
